title: Regis NLU Semantic Token Tree
description: Output contract for the EBA-style semantic token tree (prophet-workspace#76 item 7): a dependency-parsed token tree where each token carries POS + dep (syntactic head-link) + one or more typed SEMANTIC ROLE annotations. This is the syntax-plus-semantic-role layer that sits UPSTREAM of the NER MentionSet (schemas/ner/mention.schema.json) and the EL/ER resolution lane: it annotates the INFORMATION STRUCTURE of an utterance (who/what/how it relates), not specific data. Per EBA, resolution over this tree is restricted and side-effect-free. The genuine gap this fills: SynapseIQ (tree-sitter+LSP, code) owns syntax over source; regis NER owns mention/span typing; neither carries a semantic-role layer over a natural-language dependency tree.

locality.description: Scope/sovereignty boundary where this parse ran. EBA-style resolution is local-first (restricted, side-effect-free); fog/device are protective defaults.

text.description: Optional raw utterance the tokens index into. Present for auditability; the resolver never consults it as data (information structure only).

event_ir_id.description: Optional link back to the Event-IR record this utterance was normalized into.

SemanticRoleKind.description: Kept in sync with schemas/nlu/semantic-role-kind.schema.json#/$defs/SemanticRoleKind by validate_semantic_token_tree.py.

SemanticRole.description: A typed semantic-role annotation on a token. `kind` is a closed structural category; `label` is an OPEN, LEARNED symbol (e.g. ActionShow, ContactLists) — not enumerated, per 'learn, don't match dictionaries'.

label.description: Learned role symbol in UpperCamelCase (ActionShow, ContactLists, Organization, Contains, Own).

evidence.description: Structural basis for the role (e.g. 'dep=dobj', 'head=show'). Information structure only; never a specific data value.

token_id.description: Zero-based position of the token in the utterance; unique within the tree.

pos.description: Part-of-speech tag (Penn/UD-style), e.g. VB, NN, NNS, PRP, PRP$, IN, DT.

dep.description: Dependency relation to the head token.

head.description: token_id of the syntactic head. MUST be null for the ROOT token, and MUST be a valid non-self token_id for every other token (enforced by the validator/resolver).

semantic_roles.description: Typed semantic-role annotations. Load-bearing deps (ROOT/nsubj/dobj/iobj/pobj/nn/compound/prep/poss) MUST carry at least one role; function tokens (det/punct/aux/cc/...) MAY be empty. Enforced semantically by the resolver.
